title: 14.4 A 51.6TFLOPs/W Full-Datapath CIM Macro Approaching Sparsity Bound and <-30 Loss for Compound AI
problem: Compound AI (multiple specialized small models) offers edge deployment alternative to monolithic LLMs but CIM macro designs assume Gaussian data distribution (breaks with diverse model distributions), perform only MAC operations (26-72% power in partial-sum movement), and exploit model-specific sparsity patterns (rigid, not adaptable to compound-AI flexibility).
motivation: Compound AI promises better accuracy-to-size ratio on edge devices; existing CIM designs fail on diverse data distributions, data-movement bottlenecks, and inflexible sparsity patterns that compound systems demand.
method: The design uses a hardware block that computes directly in memory (CIM macro) to process different types of data distributions, not just the bell-curve patterns (Gaussian distribution) that typical designs assume. It keeps intermediate calculation results in the memory block itself—called partial-sum and residual accumulation—which drastically cuts down on how much data needs to be moved between the processor and memory, reducing the power cost from currently 26-72% of total power to minimal. It also flexibly detects when data is sparse (contains lots of zeros) rather than assuming fixed sparsity patterns, letting it adapt to different compound AI models. This achieves speedups approaching the theoretical maximum possible from exploiting sparsity.
key_novelty: The key innovation is integrating partial-sum accumulation and flexible sparsity detection into a full-datapath CIM hardware block, enabling it to handle any data distribution while reducing data-movement power from 26-72% to minimal and approaching theoretical maximum sparsity speedup.
contributions: 51.6TFLOPS/W SRAM FP CIM macro supporting compound AI
Adaptive alignment eliminating Gaussian distribution assumption
Integrated partial-sum accumulation reducing data-movement overhead
Flexible sparsity detection approaching theoretical speedup bound
primary_theme: full-datapath CIM for compound AI with adaptive sparsity
